sentences.text: Recovery is the seventh studio album by American rapper Eminem .	Eminem	Eminem

It was released on June 18 , 2010 , by Aftermath Entertainment , Shady Records , and Interscope Records as the follow-up to Eminem 's Relapse -LRB- 2009 -RRB- .	Eminem	Eminem	Aftermath	Aftermath Entertainment	Shady	Shady Records	Interscope	Interscope Records	Relapse	Relapse (Eminem album)	Aftermath Entertainment	Aftermath Entertainment	Shady Records	Shady Records	Interscope Records	Interscope Records

Originally planned to be released as Relapse 2 , the album was renamed to Recovery when Eminem found the music of the new album different from its predecessor .	Eminem	Eminem	Relapse	Relapse (Eminem album)

Production of the album took place during 2009 to 2010 at several recording studios and was handled by various record producers , including Alex da Kid , Just Blaze , Boi-1da , Jim Jonsin , DJ Khalil , Mr. Porter , and Dr. Dre .	Alex da Kid	Alex da Kid	Boi-1da	Boi-1da	Dr. Dre	Dr. Dre	DJ Khalil	DJ Khalil	Jim Jonsin	Jim Jonsin	Just Blaze	Just Blaze	Mr. Porter	Kon Artis

Eminem also collaborated with artists such as Pink , Lil Wayne , Slaughterhouse and Rihanna for the album .	Eminem	Eminem	Pink	Pink (singer)	Lil Wayne	Lil Wayne	Slaughterhouse	Slaughterhouse (group)	Rihanna	Rihanna
Recovery featured more introspective and emotional content than its predecessor and the theme of the album revolved around his positive changes , anxiety , and emotional drives .
To promote the album , he performed the album 's songs live on televised shows , at award ceremonies , musical events and also headed The Recovery Tour .	The Recovery Tour	The Recovery Tour

It spawned four singles ; `` Not Afraid '' , `` Love the Way You Lie '' , `` No Love '' , and `` Space Bound '' , with the former two both reaching number one on the Billboard Hot 100 .	Not Afraid	Not Afraid	Love the Way You Lie	Love the Way You Lie	No Love	No Love	Space Bound	Space Bound
The album has sold over 4 million copies in the United States and nearly 10 million copies worldwide .

Recovery had earned Eminem American Music Awards , Billboard Music Awards , Detroit Music Awards and Grammy Awards .	Eminem	Eminem	American Music Awards	American Music Awards	Detroit Music Awards	Detroit Music Awards	Grammy Awards	Grammy Awards
It was also nominated for Brit Awards , Juno Awards and MTV Video Music Awards Japan .	Brit Awards	Brit Awards	Juno Awards	Juno Awards	MTV Video Music Awards Japan	MTV Video Music Awards Japan
Recovery went on to become the best selling album of 2010 in the US and worldwide .

At the 2011 Grammys It was nominated for Album of the Year , Song of the Year and Record of the Year for the Album and the international chart topping single `` Love the Way You Lie '' .
